The
Workflow
02
Why JSON Prompts?
  • Plain text mixes everything — AI decides what matters
  • JSON gives every element its own dedicated field
  • Face · Lighting · Camera · Mood — all separate priorities
  • Change only the location field to move Aryan to a new Wonder
  • Organised list vs long sentence — results always better
// Plain text — unpredictable "Indian man at Taj Mahal, golden hour" // JSON — full control { "subject": "@img1 exact face", "environment": "Taj Mahal", "lighting": "golden hour", "camera": { "angle": "eye-level", "aperture": "f/2" }, "seed": 3808 }
Fixed Seed 3808 — Why?
WITHOUT SEED
Different face every generation
No consistency — useless for influencer
SEED 3808
Same face every time
Consistent across all 7 Wonders
  • Seed = the AI's starting number for building every image
  • 3808 was auto-assigned by Magnific when Fixed Seed was switched ON
  • First result was perfect — face, skin tone, hair — so it was locked permanently
  • Triple lock: Seed 3808 + @img1 reference + JSON face details = maximum consistency

Key
Learnings
04
What I Learned
  • JSON beats plain text — separate fields give the AI clear priorities for every element
  • Fixed seed + character reference = only reliable way to keep a face consistent
  • Real tourist references make AI images look 10× more natural and authentic
  • Camera settings matter — focal length and aperture completely change the mood
  • AI tools are only as good as the workflow behind them — build a system, not just a prompt
